Package ca.refundr.highspring.domain.admin

Record Class ErrorLogResponse

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
ca.refundr.highspring.domain.admin.ErrorLogResponse
Record Components:
id - row id in api_error_log
level - log level string (typically ERROR)
loggerName - logger / source name stored with the event
message - short failure message
stackTrace - full stack trace text (may be long)
requestMethod - HTTP method of the failing request, if known
requestPath - request URI (may include query string) of the failing call
userId - signed-in user when the error happened; null if anonymous
createdAt - when the error was persisted
public record ErrorLogResponse(long id, String level, String loggerName, String message, String stackTrace, String requestMethod, String requestPath, UUID userId, Instant createdAt) extends Record
One serious server error saved for admins to review.
